Z3 inputs: https://zenodo.org/records/16740866/files/QF_NIA.tar.zst?download=1
Z3 commit message: nla: maintain integrality of integer columns during LP bound optimization

Thread the integrality quantum (min_gain) from theory_arith::max_min through
the monomial_bounds simplex walk: init_gains seeds min_gain=1 for integer
columns, update_gains raises it to the lcm of the denominators of the pivot
coefficients over integer basic columns and rounds both the max gain and the
per-step increment down to that quantum (normalize_gain). Columns entering at
non-integral values are rejected (unsafe gain), and non-unit quanta count as
best-effort progress. As a result every move is a multiple of the quantum, so
integer columns keep integral values throughout the walk. Also fixes the
objective-direction sign when the basic column's row coefficient is negative.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
Copilot-Session: 84b07e32-6458-4ea9-bf14-1cecfb7f1a99
